prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one Impeccable visual-direction card sketch
Primary request: Create a challenger design-world sketch for a desktop React application used repeatedly by quantity surveyors to review hundreds of beam and column records extracted from construction drawing PDFs, resolve AI ambiguities using linked drawing evidence, edit records, and export validated data. Translate international airport wayfinding into a focused chain of review decisions without depicting a literal airport.
Scene/backdrop: flat matte unfinished interface concept on a neutral pale drafting-paper field, contained within a single landscape 16:9 card.
Subject: drawing evidence is visually dominant; the next ambiguity is unmistakable; a member path/progress system visibly re-signs after each answer. Show one large cropped technical drawing evidence plane, one monumental member ID, a short decisive sequence of record stops, a clear unresolved decision, and compact edit/export affordances. Use saturated yellow navigation bands only for the next decision, black humanist sans typography, white pictograms inside black inset squares, and strict edge arrows.
Style/medium: high-end product design sketch, flat vector-like matte shapes, deliberately unfinished but spatially rigorous, screen-design concept board, no gloss, no photorealism, no literal airport scene.
Composition/framing: landscape 16:9, same framing as a polished direction-card thumbnail; asymmetrical and focused; one dominant evidence region with a compact decision rail and directional progress spine. Avoid equal three-panel layouts. Strong hierarchy, generous negative space, cropped content suggesting hundreds of records.
Lighting/mood: none; flat graphic editorial treatment; decisive, operational, calm.
Color palette: saturated airport yellow, ink black, warm white, graphite gray; yellow reserved strictly for actionable next-decision signage.
Materials/textures: matte paper, subtle construction-drawing grain, crisp black rules and arrows.
Text (verbatim): "Structural Drawing Assistant"
Constraints: The only legible text anywhere must be exactly “Structural Drawing Assistant”. Render all other labels, IDs, numbers, dimensions, buttons, records, annotations, and metadata as intentionally indistinct greeked bars or abstract glyphs, not readable words. Do not add any other legible text. No factual claims.
Avoid: literal airport imagery, aircraft, terminals, baggage, people, generic dashboard cards, equal three panels, excessive chrome, tiny dense controls, chat UI, gradients, glassmorphism, gloss, photorealism, fake brand logos, additional readable text.
